retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait of a muscular figure with boxing wraps, featuring bold blocky typography and a cyan halftone overlay.
excludeWhen: the subject is a landscape or object

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-key, high-contrast black and white photograph of a muscular man with tattoos and hand wraps, positioned against a dark background. The lower third features a heavy, blocky typographic treatment in cyan and white, integrated with a blue halftone dot pattern that fades into the shadows.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's white hand wraps as the primary light-value focal point
Cyan block lettering anchored to the bottom-left quadrant
Halftone dot gradient bridging the gap between text and subject
High-contrast lighting defining muscle anatomy against deep shadows
coreInvariants: Monochrome subject with a single-color accent (Cyan)
Halftone texture in the lower graphic layer

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered muscular torso and head, filling the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white boxing wraps on the raised fist.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the white hand wraps, moves down to the bold cyan text, then across to the advisory label in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows surrounding the subject's head and shoulders.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white monochrome for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cyan (process blue) for the primary display text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for secondary text and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the subject; high saturation in the cyan graphic elements.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Letters are tightly packed with zero kerning
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'N' and 'M' equivalents are solid blocks with thin vertical slits
The 'E' has three equal horizontal bars with no vertical stem on the right
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pair ultra-heavy block display text with a smaller, stencil-like or industrial sans-serif for subtitles.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the secondary text.
The primary display text is more like a logo/graphic than a standard font.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a muscular man with boxing wraps and tattoos, lit from the side to emphasize muscle definition, against a dark background. Leave the bottom third darker for text placement.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a cyan halftone dot gradient across the bottom third. Place ultra-bold, blocky cyan text in the bottom left, and a white industrial-style subtitle directly beneath it.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text cyan and blocky?
Is there a halftone dot pattern in the lower section?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the accent color (e.g., cyan vs. red)

avoid: Messy or overlapping text that obscures the subject's face

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on the torso
Verify the cyan color matches the intended urban aesthetic
Ensure the block text is legible despite its weight
Confirm the halftone pattern fades correctly into the black background
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome high-contrast photography + single-color block typography + halftone texture overlay.
